query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN path LIKE '/src/%' OR path LIKE '/@%' OR path LIKE '/node_modules/%' OR path LIKE '/__vite%' OR path LIKE '/client/%' OR path LIKE '%.tsx' OR path LIKE '%.ts' OR path LIKE '%.css' OR path LIKE '%.js' OR path LIKE '%.map' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dev_paths,
  SUM(CASE WHEN path NOT LIKE '/src/%' AND path NOT LIKE '/@%' AND path NOT LIKE '/node_modules/%' AND path NOT LIKE '/__vite%' AND path NOT LIKE '/client/%' AND path NOT LIKE '%.tsx' AND path NOT LIKE '%.ts' AND path NOT LIKE '%.css' AND path NOT LIKE '%.js' AND path NOT LIKE '%.map' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as real_pages,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ip) as total_ips
FROM visitor_logs;
